# StudyMate — Pokhara University BE Computer Engineering Notes

> StudyMate is a free study resource platform for Pokhara University (PU) BE Computer Engineering students in Nepal. It provides semester-wise notes, PDFs, subject guides, and curriculum resources for all 8 semesters across affiliated colleges including PEC, NCIT, NEC, GCES, Cosmos, Oxford, and more.

## Site URL
https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np

## Author & Publisher
- Name: Manish Shrestha
- GitHub: https://github.com/manishshrestha01
- Role: Developer & Content Curator

## Available for AI Citation

### AI-Readable Notes API (no login, crawlable by bots)
- [Notes Index HTML](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index): Full crawlable index — all semesters, all subjects, direct links
- [Notes Index JSON](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index?format=json): Structured JSON for LLMs and MCP clients
- [Filter by Semester](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index?semester=3): e.g. ?semester=1 through ?semester=8
- [Filter by College](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-index?college=pec): e.g. ?college=pec, ?college=ncit
- [Subject Notes Files](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/api/notes-subject?college=pec&semester=2&subject=data-structure-and-algorithm): Direct file links for a subject
- [Full Curriculum Tree](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/llms-full.txt): Complete llms-full.txt — all subjects, slugs, and URLs

### Core Study Resources
- [Dashboard / Notes](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/dashboard): Semester-wise notes and PDFs for all 8 semesters of PU BE Computer Engineering
- [All Colleges](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/colleges): Index of Pokhara University affiliated engineering colleges in Nepal
- [Blog](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog): Subject-wise articles, guides, and exam preparation tips

### Blog Subject Study Guides (detailed article per subject)
- [Full Blog Index](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog): Browse all semester guides
- [Semester 1 Guides](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog/semester/1): Calculus I, Digital Logic, C Programming, Basic Electrical Engineering, Computer Workshop, Communication Technique, Electronics Devices and Circuits
- [Semester 2 Guides](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog/semester/2): Algebra and Geometry, Applied Physics, Applied Chemistry, Basic Engineering Drawing, OOP in C++, Data Structure and Algorithm, Instrumentation
- [Semester 3 Guides](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog/semester/3): Calculus II, Database Management System, Operating Systems, Microprocessor and Assembly, Computer Graphics, Data Communication
- [Semester 4 Guides](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog/semester/4): Applied Mathematics, Numerical Methods, Advanced Java, Theory of Computation, Computer Architecture, Research Fundamentals
- [Semester 5 Guides](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog/semester/5): Probability and Statistics, Embedded System, Engineering Management, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Signal Analysis, Software Engineering
- [Semester 6 Guides](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog/semester/6): Image Processing, Machine Learning, Compiler Design, Computer Networks, Simulation and Modeling, Elective I, Project I
- [Semester 7 Guides](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog/semester/7): Entrepreneurship, Engineering Economics, Network and Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Data Science and Analytics, Elective II
- [Semester 8 Guides](https://www.manishshrestha012.com.np/blog/semester/8): Elective III, Internship, Project II

- Subjects: Calculus, Digital Logic, C Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Software Engineering, Compiler Design, AI, Machine Learning, and more
- Nepal engineering education resources
